objective: Advance historical lifecycle qualification, freeze a catalyst experiment and measure bounded native research-task efficiency without upgrading incomplete evidence into strategy or whole-stack acceptance.

waves.state: six captured sources and three claims / offline native proof accepted
frozen daily and intraday protocol / synthetic mechanics accepted
eight native invocations / semantic pass / two word-contract failures
independent review accepted / publication integrity and CI recorded separately

constraints.default_runtime: Existing accepted native SDKs and client routes; no dependency or model upgrade by default
constraints.provider_data_acquisition: Only a reviewed fixed read-only plan; coordinator executes authenticated requests

acceptance: Lifecycle cases distinguish security identity, company identity, query symbol, claimed effective time, original publication/revision and local observation. Unknown or unsupported fields remain explicit.
Reuse immutable prior rename acquisition. Any new provider request must have a concrete unmet question, fixed scope and finite request cap; no broad price/outcome scan.

Daily and intraday hypotheses specify candidate selection, source availability, event age, latency, labels, exits, costs, controls, chronological partitions and research-only promotion criteria before outcome inspection.
The inspected 2021 control segment and any other inspected sample cannot be represented as untouched holdout. Missing, losing and rejected cases remain in experiment accounting.
Native offline exercises establish protocol mechanics only. They cannot establish empirical strategy quality or fill realism.

Efficiency conditions use the same frozen research task/corpus/model settings within each provider, preserve answer quality and report complete available usage. Unknown categories and uncontrolled cache/retry effects remain explicit.
Independent review precedes publication. Exact native commands, failures, artifact hashes, dashboard scope and GitHub commit validation are recorded.
next_dependent_gates: Permitted historical universe and original availability/revision policy before broad as-known catalyst strategy evaluation
Realistic fill, liquidity, financing and latency calibration before interpreting leveraged simulation merit
Numeric risk, journal, idempotency, reconciliation and recovery acceptance before dedicated paper execution
Operational off-host recovery, second-machine/macOS and provider cancellation acceptance
